children: American Rebel secured two convertible promissory notes totaling $137,500—$82,500 from Monroe Street Capital and $55,000 from Lambda Ventures—to support operational consolidation and working capital. Each 12-month note carries an original issue discount and a one-time 15% interest charge, with conversion rights at 75% of the lowest traded price upon default or mutual consent. The company received net proceeds of $115,000, issued 64,000 commitment shares, and reserved 40,000,000 shares for potential conversions. Amortization begins March 1, 2027, with total scheduled payments of $94,875 to Monroe and $63,250 to Lambda.
